question: Calculate the value of the following trigonometric expression: sin 40 cos 20 + cos 40 sin 20
solution:
**Given:**

sin 40 cos 20 + cos 40 sin 20

**Formula used:**

sin A cos B + cos A sin B = sin(A + B)

**Calculation:**

⇒ sin 40 cos 20 + cos 40 sin 20

⇒ sin(40 + 20)

⇒ sin 60

⇒ √3 / 2

**∴ The value of the expression is √3 / 2.**
